key_insight: Subspace Tuning (SST) reduces catastrophic forgetting by constraining fine-tuning updates to the bottom singular subspace, preserving principal directions while still learning new tasks.
engineering_relevance: For LLM fine-tuning pipelines, SST offers a drop-in, optimizer-agnostic way to improve continual learning and retention without sacrificing target-task performance.
method: Project each weight update into the bottom singular subspace to eliminate changes along principal directions.
Combine subspace protection with dense gradient estimation for effective learning under the constraint.
Use a simple refresh mechanism and compose SST with SFT or self-distillation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that protecting up to 99% of the weight subspace improves retention while maintaining strong task performance, with 2–4× less KL drift than baseline recipes and near-elimination of forgetting in large models.
watch_item: Computing and maintaining singular subspaces adds implementation overhead, so the method may be sensitive to how often subspaces are refreshed and how well it scales in practice.
paper_title: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
